abstract: We studied cytokeratin (CK) expression immunohistochemically in 64 seminomas using a panel of commercially available antikeratin antibodies and tested for association of CK expression with patient age, tumor size, stage, and outcome. Seventeen embryonal carcinomas were compared with seminoma. CK7, CAM 5.2, AEI/AEIII, and wide-spectrum screening keratin (WSK) were positive in 41%, 30%, 36%, and 36% of the seminomas, respectively. CK20 and high-molecular-weight keratin (HMWK) were negative in all cases. CD30, placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP), and epithelial membrane antigen (EMA) were positive in 6%, 100%, and 2% of cases, respectively. There were no differences in patient age, stage, tumor size, or outcome between CK-positive and CK-negative seminomas. CK7, CAM 5.2, AEI/AEIII, and WSK were positive in 100%, 88%, 94%, and 88% of embryonal carcinomas, respectively. CK20 and HMWK were negative in all cases. CD30, EMA, and PLAP were positive in 100%, 12%, and 76%, respectively. CKs are present in seminoma, and their presence is not associated with a difference in patient age, stage, or outcome. In cases such as small needle biopsy specimens, CK and CD30 stains may be useful in separating seminoma from embryonal carcinoma.
abstract_ja: 精巣セミノーマ64例のサイトケラチン(CK)発現を、各種抗ケラチン抗体パネルを用いて免疫組織化学的に検討し、CK発現と患者年齢、腫瘍径、病期、予後との関連を検定した。胎児性癌17例と比較した。CK7、CAM 5.2、AE1/AE3、WSKはセミノーマのそれぞれ41%、30%、36%、36%で陽性であった。CK20とHMWKは全例陰性であった。CD30、PLAP、EMAはそれぞれ6%、100%、2%の症例で陽性であった。CK陽性とCK陰性のセミノーマの間で、患者年齢、病期、腫瘍径、予後に差はなかった。胎児性癌ではCK7、CAM 5.2、AE1/AE3、WSKがそれぞれ100%、88%、94%、88%で陽性であり、CK20とHMWKは全例陰性であった。CD30、EMA、PLAPはそれぞれ100%、12%、76%で陽性であった。セミノーマにもCKは存在するが、その有無は患者年齢、病期、予後の差と関連しなかった。小さな針生検検体などでは、CKおよびCD30染色がセミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別に有用でありうる。
